{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_ids before deduplication
unique_patients_before = df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Unique patient_ids before deduplication: {unique_patients_before}')

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to prepare for deduplication
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Deduplicate: keep only the first row (highest sample_seq) for each patient
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
unique_patients_after = df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Unique patient_ids after deduplication: {unique_patients_after}')

# Confirm the deduplication worked
df_dedup.head(3)"}
